scene: Inferno IV — Limbo: Virgil among his own
narrative: Dante wakes with a thunderclap at the first circle after the unobserved Acheron crossing
Virgil appears pale from compassion for the spirits, not from fear
The souls in Limbo possess virtue or wisdom but lack the hope of blessedness in Dante's theology
Virgil belongs to this realm, yet guides the living Dante through it
Homer, Horace, Ovid and Lucan greet Virgil, then welcome Dante as sixth among the poets
Together they pass through seven gates of the noble castle into a green meadow
Dante and Virgil leave the company and continue toward the next circle
